newsitem.title: USA: V-One sees Q2 revs below expectations.
newsitem.headline: V-One sees Q2 revs below expectations.

text.p: V-One Corp said Monday it expects to report second quarter revenues of about $2.1 million, which it said is "considerably below expectations."
The company reported $1.4 million in revenues for the same period a year ago.
Analysts consensus estimates for the quarter is a loss of $0.03 per share, according to First Call.
The company will announce final results July 24.

A V-One spokesman said the company's business -- providing security on the Internet -- has not "matured" as quickly as it had initially expected. He said the company will provide more information when it releases its earnings July 24.

In a written statement announcing the second quarter revenue expectations, V-One president and chief executive James Chen said, "V-One has invested substantially in its marketing efforts and we are disappointed that results have not been acheived as promptly as anticipated."
The company also said it has recently won contracts which can represent "substantial revenue" in the third quarter and beyond.
